key.label: Key
key.description: Stable unique identifier for this mech RP (used by modifiers, cooldown tracking, and law-scoring). Do not change once other content references it.

display_name.label: Display Name
display_name.description: Human-readable name shown to admins and (on success/failure) to players

description.label: Description
description.description: Flavor text describing what attempting this mech RP represents

base_difficulty.label: Base Difficulty
base_difficulty.description: The DC for the roll. For Grant Resources mech RPs, this is only the fallback DC for a resource not listed in Resource Difficulty below.

relevant_stats.label: Relevant Stats
relevant_stats.description: Which character stats this mech RP can use. At resolution time, one of these is picked at random (not the character's best) to represent the acting character's contribution.

goal_affinity.label: Goal Affinity
goal_affinity.description: How relevant this mech RP is to each AI strategic goal. The AI selection layer uses this as its primary signal for which mech RPs to attempt each session.

requirements.label: Requirements
requirements.description: All conditions that must hold for the AI to consider this mech RP a valid candidate this session.

effect_type.label: Effect Type
effect_type.description: Which code-side handler resolves this mech RP's outcome

law_axis.label: Law Axis (Change Law only)
law_axis.description: Only used when Effect Type is Change Law. Must exactly match one of the nation schema's law-axis property names (e.g. 'diplomatic_stance', 'government_type', 'scientific_stance'). Ignored for all other effect types. Do NOT use 'stability' here — that field is an earned progress track (moved one level at a time by stability_gain_chance/stability_loss_chance rolls, via an Adjust Stability mech RP instead), not a freely-selectable policy choice like the other law axes; letting Change Law target it would let a single roll skip straight to the top level.

resource_difficulty.label: Resource Difficulty (Grant Resources only)
resource_difficulty.description: Only used when Effect Type is Grant Resources. Per-resource DC — the AI picks whichever listed resource it needs most and rolls against that resource's difficulty. A resource not listed here falls back to Base Difficulty.

tier_magnitude_critical_success.label: Magnitude: Critical Success
tier_magnitude_critical_success.description: Effect magnitude on a Critical Success (e.g. tiles claimed, resource units, stability levels, money amount — meaning depends on Effect Type)

cooldown_sessions.label: Cooldown (Sessions)
cooldown_sessions.description: How many sessions must pass before this exact mech RP can be attempted again by the same nation. 0 = always repeatable.

active.label: Active
active.description: Inactive mech RPs are never offered to the AI selection layer, but are kept for reference instead of being deleted
